verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms mise serves a proper llms.txt file at the root of its docs site (HTTP 200, valid content listing guides), which is exactly what lets an AI agent be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, other agent-friendly doc formats (e.g. markdown mirrors of pages) return 404, and there's no evidence of an OpenAPI spec or additional agent-discovery surfaces. missing for 10: confirmation that individual doc pages have agent-readable (.md) mirrors, and any first-party mention/documentation of the llms.txt feature itself.
